parole.significato: swarm (a mass of people or animals in turmoil)
parole.testo: Unknown. Hypothetical derivations include: * Hebrew בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא (barúkh habá), a greeting used by Jews; * Latin Berecynthia, a goddess whose feasts were accompanied by orgies; * influence of confundir (“to confuse”). Compare Spanish barahúnda, Asturian baragaña, French baragouin.
